scope: Public black-box CLI checks for test-on-request plus existing repository regression suite

authorship.basis: CLI contract supplied before implementation; agreed clarifications after first execution

contract_clarifications: After-phase provenance is the structured value post_hoc; prompt may use underscores.
Public brief excludes candidate data; explicitly passing --candidate is rejected rather than ignored.

runs.classification: Two test expectations clarified; no product fix required.

runs.limitation: Three pre-existing test_preview cases could not bind 127.0.0.1: PermissionError. All 21 test-on-request cases passed.

limitations: Public development tests; no protected evaluator or independent hidden holdout was exercised.
CLI artifact checks do not establish OS-enforced isolation of agents or exhaustive absence of out-of-scope reads.
